hooks.command: p=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path) // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; r="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$r" ] || r=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] || r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] || r=$PWD; case "$f" in "$r"/*) f=${f#"$r"/} ;; ./*) f=${f#./} ;; esac; case "$f" in spec/*) if grep -q '^- \*\*Status:\*\* Approved' "$r"/proposals/*.md 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo "blocked: spec/ is read-only unless an approved spec proposal under proposals/ is pending application. Stage edits via the change-proposal skill, record approval, then apply with the implement-proposal skill. Path: $f" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
